title: Monarch Mag Viral DNA/RNA Extraction Protocol for KingFisher Flex
author: Juliet Bonnevie

steps.title: Configure KingFisher Flex Instrument
steps.instruction: Ensure the instrument is equipped with the KingFisher Flex 96 Deep Well head and a compatible KingFisher 96 microplate (200 μl) heating block.

steps.title: Set Up MagMAX Program
steps.instruction: Load the MagMAX Pathogen RNA/DNA (High Volume) program and modify it to include three 500 μl wash steps, a 2-minute bead drying step, and a 33–100 μl elution.

substeps.instruction: Enter sample, wash, and elution volumes into the program.
Select plate sizes: KingFisher 96-deep well plates (2.0 ml) for sample and wash plates; KingFisher 96 microplate (200 μl) for elution.

steps.title: Prepare Viral DNA/RNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Wash Buffer in a nuclease-free tube or bottle, preparing up to 15% excess volume.

substeps.instruction: Combine 167 μl Monarch Buffer BX and 83 μl Nuclease-free Water per reaction.
Vortex to mix.
Add 250 μl Isopropanol per reaction.
Vortex to mix (Total Volume: 500 μl).

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Lysis Buffer Bead Mix immediately before use, preparing up to 15% excess volume.

substeps.instruction: Vortex magnetic beads to form a homogeneous solution.
Combine 200 μl Monarch StabiLyse DNA/RNA Buffer and 1 μl Monarch Carrier RNA per reaction.
Vortex to mix.
Add 200 μl Isopropanol per reaction and vortex to mix.
Add 20 μl Monarch Mag Beads M1 per reaction and gently vortex to mix (Total Volume: 421 μl).
Store at room temperature, periodically inverting or vortexing to keep beads in suspension.

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Plates
steps.instruction: Aliquot reagents into the specified plates and seal with adhesive film until use.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 500 μl Viral DNA/RNA Wash buffer to wells in one 96-well deep well plate.
Aliquot 500 μl 80% ethanol to wells in two 96-well deep well plates.
Aliquot 33–100 μl nuclease-free Water to wells in one 96-well microplate.

steps.title: Resuspend Nanotrap Particles
steps.instruction: Perform these steps following the enrichment phase (e.g., after Step 11 of Protocol APP-042).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μl Monarch StabiLyse DNA/RNA Buffer to the Nanotrap Particle pellet.
Pipette to resuspend the pellet.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Separate Particles and Transfer Supernatant
steps.instruction: Use a compatible magnetic rack to separate Nanotrap Particles from the sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a KingFisher-compatible deepwell plate.

steps.title: Perform Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for lysis in the sample plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μl nuclease-free water to the Nanotrap enriched sample.
Add 5 μl Proteinase K (Note: nuclease water and Proteinase K can be combined as a master mix).
Pipette the mix or use a thermomixer for 30 seconds after sealing the plate.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Add the prepared bead mix to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Gently vortex the Lysis Buffer Bead Mix.
Add 421 μl of the mix to each sample well.
Seal the plate with adhesive film.

steps.title: Run KingFisher Flex Extraction
steps.instruction: Load the plates and execute the automated program.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove adhesive film from sample, wash, and elution plates.
Load sample plate, wash plates (1-3), elution plate, and tip comb/plate into the appropriate positions on the worktable.
Run the modified MagMAX program.

steps.title: Store Eluted DNA/RNA
steps.instruction: Upon completion of the run, seal the elution plate with adhesive film.

substeps.instruction: Place on ice for immediate use or freeze for storage.
